what_changed: Nothing on this site said what a missing government response does not mean. A reader who found a recommendation and read that no response had been tabled could take away that nothing was done about it, and that inference is not available from anything this site holds. A government can act on a recommendation without ever answering the committee - a budget measure, a regulation, an agency's own decision - and it can answer a committee at length and act on nothing.
